name: chart_a_course_no_discard_after_attack
notes: Pad508e35a0 G4. Printed: 'Draw two cards. Then discard a card unless you attacked this turn.' Seat 0 attacks with a 2/2 Bear (seat 1 takes 2), then casts Chart a Course ({1}{U}) in its postcombat main phase: it draws two cards and discards nothing (no discard is asked: the step carries no decision), so seat 0 holds the Spare card and the two drawn cards, and only Chart a Course is in its graveyard.
